description: This file defines a custom exception class 'InvalidArgumentException' within the OrangeHRM installer namespace, extending the built-in PHP InvalidArgumentException. It includes a static method for generating exceptions related to exceeding character limits.

classes.name: InvalidArgumentException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's built-in InvalidArgumentException, adding a static method to generate exceptions when input exceeds a specified length.

methods.name: shouldNotExceedCharacters
methods.description: Static factory method that creates an instance of InvalidArgumentException with a message indicating the character limit exceeded.
